offering_description.value: Wendy's sells prepared meals to consumers through company-operated and franchised quick-service restaurants. It licenses its restaurant brand and operating system to franchisees and leases certain restaurant sites to them.

primary_products.value: hamburgers; chicken sandwiches and nuggets; french fries; frozen dairy desserts; breakfast sandwiches

primary_services.value: quick-service meal preparation and serving; restaurant franchising; restaurant site leasing

customer_segment.value: B2C: Dine-in, drive-through, takeout and delivery customers; B2B: Restaurant franchise operators

revenue_model.value: product sales: Prepared food and beverages at company-operated restaurants; licensing or royalties: Initial franchise fees and ongoing royalties for use of the brand and operating system; rental or leasing: Rent from franchisees for certain restaurant properties
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Prepares meals from purchased ingredients and serves consumers; brand owner: Develops menus and operating standards and licenses the restaurant concept to franchisees; asset operator: Operates owned and leased restaurant sites that serve consumers
value_chain_position.category: service provider; brand owner; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Latin America, the Caribbean, Europe, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: niche specialist: A single quick-service hamburger restaurant concept operated through company locations and franchises

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated dining rooms, takeout counters and drive-throughs; partners / resellers: Franchised restaurants and third-party delivery platforms; online: Company website and mobile app for ordering

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Restaurant food safety, sanitation and health inspections, plus franchise disclosure rules
